ranked.name: Hypochlorous acid face and body spray 2-pack, 3.4 oz
ranked.angle: Opaque, stable bottle with a dated expiry and cosmetic-only positioning.
ranked.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA (facility registration, product listing, safety substantiation). Avoid 'treats acne/eczema' (drug) and 'disinfects/kills germs' (EPA pesticide registration under FIFRA). Amazon beauty may ask for documents.
ranked.notes: 5-year search growth +8,900% (Exploding Topics). Ulta comp: $27 per 4 oz. Private-label sources: Pravada MOQ 50-250; Alibaba-sourced listings $0.65-1.06/unit but unverified. I used $3 per unit contract-made in the US and 0% duty (US fill; imported components not included). Orders/year guess.

ranked.name: Fluoride-free nano-hydroxyapatite toothpaste, 3-pack of 3.4 oz tubes
ranked.angle: Smooth 10% nHA formula in a 3-pack with a refill-by-mail option, compared against Boka/Apagard.
ranked.regulatory_notes: Fluoride-free toothpaste is generally a cosmetic: MoCRA facility registration, product listing, safety substantiation, ingredient labeling, adverse event reporting. Do not claim to treat or prevent cavities or remineralize enamel (drug claims). Fluoride versions are OTC drugs.
ranked.notes: 5-year search growth +6,200% (Exploding Topics). Supplier listings show $0.26-0.70 per tube (MOQ 72-10,000), but those are bare tubes; I used $2.50 per tube for a contract-made, boxed product. 1.8 orders/yr is a guess; a tube lasts ~6 weeks. Duty guess is 7.5% List 4A + 12.5%.

ranked.name: Peptide eye cream, 0.5 oz, 2-pack
ranked.angle: Airless pump, fragrance-free formula, 2-pack sized for 3 months.
ranked.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA: facility registration and product listing, safety substantiation, label ingredients. No claims to repair collagen or treat wrinkles at a structural level (drug claims). Expect Amazon beauty gating.
ranked.notes: Exploding Topics: 6,600/mo, +325%. Private-label quotes conflict: $2.40-4.80 at 500u in one guide vs $4-22 in another; I used $6 per jar x2. Orders/yr 1.8 is a guess. Heavily competed by established brands.
